issue.title: Case-sensitivity in OCI still does not work

repository.name: yii2
repository.description: Yii 2: The Fast, Secure and Professional PHP Framework

issue.body:
I have OCI driver declaration to put all results to the lower case:

``` php
        'attributes' => [
            PDO::ATTR_CASE => PDO::CASE_LOWER,
        ],
```

This means that I want ALL query results coming from OCI driver should have column names in the lower case. However, with AR classes I still have those populated incorrectly or not populated at all, because OCI driver in Yii2 reads the schema in the upper case and populates AR `attributes` with upper case column names values, resulting in failures when trying to access properties of AR class.

So far I'm unable to work with OCI AR classes at all.

Yii 2.0.5
